label: Autoline

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). autoline.ee is Linemedia's Autoline (Estonia); Linemedia API v5 lets registered API users publish/manage adverts on Autoline/Machineryline/Agroline; registration via support.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://api-docs.linemedia.com/v5/): autoline.ee is Linemedia's Autoline (Estonia); Linemedia API v5 lets registered API users publish/manage adverts on Autoline/Machineryline/Agroline; registration via support. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
